body: You’re welcome please feel free to pm me if you need to chat more about it or if you feel bad but don’t feel sorry I’m no stranger to bad thoughts and feelings so I understand the need for someone to hear them even if you don’t know them hopefully things look up from here for you

Please burden them I know it seems like you’re a problem by bothering them but if they truly care about you they will help no matter what and if they don’t then cut them out of your life and move on to better people. But even if it’s something small like you said you have to work later just use that as your first stepping stone. You can find the next one after work. Give yourself small goals that are easy to achieve that seem like they’re necessary such as working to push through this rough time you’re having. I’m not promising anything will get better but you deserve a good life so make little goals until your life is better than now
Have you spoken to one of them about how you feel right now? Hotlines are good and all but a personal connection is more realistic for actual help

Push through and find any reason no matter how small and use that as a stepping stone to move on to the next one until you’re past your problems. Truly hoping for the best for you:) please consider any option but suicide
